temporal_split.known_bias: excluded conversations are long-running by construction, so the splits under-represent long conversations. The alternative -- splitting a conversation across windows -- would be a leakage path, so this trade was taken deliberately and is reported rather than hidden.

dedup_policy: Cross-split text dedup deliberately NOT applied: identical questions from different customers are legitimate historical precedent, and dropping them systematically strips the later (evaluation) splits. Leakage is closed by conversation-level time-ordered splitting plus a strict time filter at retrieval. gold_pool is deduplicated within itself, and gold items with an exact twin in history are FLAGGED for slice analysis, not deleted.
